davinfifield.name: mp3-chinese-pinyin-sound
davinfifield.author: davinfifield (GitHub); the speaker is not credited in the source

notes: The davinfifield pack covers tones 1–4 only. Its files named as neutral tone (ma5, ma, de5, de, le5, ne5, zi) are byte-identical copies of the first-tone files and are not used, so neutral-tone cells have no native audio.

The pack records all four tones for every syllable, including tones that do not occur in Mandarin, and a few combinations that are not syllables (diang, shong, rei, muo, nia, lün). Those files are not used.
